text:
maria: Customer reported 429s right after we showed the deprecation banner. Their SDK still sends X-Client-Version: 1 but they say requests landed on v2.

derek: Routing should honor X-Client-Version; fallback to compat only when header missing.

zane: Banner click writes tenant flag async (console). Could be a race between cached routing and console toggle.

ira: The real concern is quota mapping. v2 token-cost profile differs. If route executed as compat -> v2 but quota accounted under v2, tenants could hit limits.

maria: Which telemetry fields will show this pattern?

derek: Check route.selected (e.g., compat/v1->v2), quota.accounted_as, quota.delta_tokens, and route.snapshot_id if present.

ira: Proposal: make routing decision + quota accounting atomic by tying both to a config snapshot id. Emit snapshot id in events.

zane: UX: change banner modal to warn about transient errors and show "retry" CTA rather than silently toggling.

derek: Plan: 1) run queries to detect mismatches, 2) instrument snapshot id, 3) snap-based quota lookup, 4) banner copy + retry CTA, 5) canary.

maria: I'll run the query this afternoon and post results.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: patch/banner-copy v1 -> prod @ 1764327825

ira: I'll draft an alert for compat-routing-quota-mismatch and add playbook steps.

maria: Thanks team — let's reconvene after results.
